definitions: An appearance of light, especially one which is indistinct or small, or short-lived.
An indistinct sign of something; a glimpse or hint.
Chiefly in conjunction with an adverb: to cause (light) to shine.
To shine, especially in an indistinct or intermittent manner; to glisten, to glitter.

blocks.text: Gleam  is a live album recorded in 1975 by jazz trumpeter Freddie Hubbard. It was released as a double LP on CBS/Sony and features a live performance recorded in Tokyo by Hubbard, Carl Randall, George Cables, Henry Franklin, Carl Burnett and Buck Clark.
The Gleam is an album by saxophonist Steve Lacy's Sextet, recorded in 1986 and released on the Swedish Silkheart label.
Gleam is a general-purpose, concurrent, functional, high-level programming language that compiles to Erlang or JavaScript source code.
